# CBTMocks - Free Mock Tests for Competitive Exams (CAT, XAT, SNAP)

> CBTMocks (https://cbtmocks.online/) is a 100% free open-access Computer Based Test (CBT) portal for Indian MBA competitive examinations: Common Admission Test (CAT), Xavier Aptitude Test (XAT), and Symbiosis National Aptitude Test (SNAP). It provides 65+ full-length and sectional mocks with authentic test interfaces, official scoring (+3/-1 for CAT, +1/-0.25 for XAT/SNAP), draggable virtual calculator (CAT), 5-option MCQs & Decision Making caselets (XAT), 60-minute speed tests (SNAP), and instant percentiles with zero paywalls, zero ads during active tests, and no sign-up required.

## Core Free Mock Test Modules by Exam

### 1. Common Admission Test (CAT)
- [Free CAT Mock Tests & Sectionals](https://cbtmocks.online/cat.html): Comprehensive SEO portal & syllabus guide.
- [CAT 120-Minute Official Full Mocks](https://cbtmocks.online/#/cat/full-mocks): Authentic 3-section simulation (VARC 40m, DILR 40m, QA 40m) with 66 questions, 198 marks, +3/-1 marking, and on-screen calculator.
- [CAT 40-Minute Sectional Tests](https://cbtmocks.online/#/cat/tests): Timed papers for VARC (24 Qs), DILR (20 Qs), and Quantitative Aptitude (22 Qs) from CAT 2020 to 2026 specimen papers.

### 2. Xavier Aptitude Test (XAT)
- [Free XAT Mock Tests & DM Sectionals](https://cbtmocks.online/xat.html): Dedicated XLRI portal, Decision Making strategy, and scoring guide.
- [XAT 175-Minute Official Full Mocks](https://cbtmocks.online/#/xat/full-mocks): Official XAT 2024, XAT 2023, and 2026 Specimen mocks (75 Qs, 5 options A-E, +1.0/-0.25 marking).
- [XAT Decision Making (DM) Sectionals](https://cbtmocks.online/#/xat/tests): Real managerial caselets (NeoPharma, EcoCraft, TechSprint, Medix, FinServe) with ethical dilemmas and elimination strategies.
- [XAT VALR & QA-DI Sectionals](https://cbtmocks.online/#/xat/tests): High-level abstract reading comprehension, critical reasoning, geometry, and multi-chart DI sets.

### 3. Symbiosis National Aptitude Test (SNAP)
- [Free SNAP Mock Tests & Speed Sectionals](https://cbtmocks.online/snap.html): Complete Symbiosis SIBM Pune & SCMHRD guide.
- [SNAP 60-Minute Speed Full Mocks](https://cbtmocks.online/#/snap/full-mocks): 60 questions in 60 minutes, +1/-0.25 marking, no sectional time limits.
- [SNAP Sectionals](https://cbtmocks.online/#/snap/tests): General English (15 Qs), Analytical & Logical Reasoning (25 Qs), and Quantitative, DI & Data Sufficiency (20 Qs).

## Performance History & Revision Tools
- [Tests Given Performance History](https://cbtmocks.online/#/history): Local storage analytics tracking past attempt scores, section-wise accuracy, percentiles, and solutions.
- [Bookmarked Questions Review](https://cbtmocks.online/#/bookmarks): Saved challenging questions for revision before exam day.

## About CBTMocks & Anti-Paywall Mission
- [About Us & Our Mission](https://cbtmocks.online/about.html): Our mission to end predatory ₹5,000 to ₹15,000 coaching paywalls, demo-mock marketing bait, and intrusive telemarketing calls.
- [Coaching Comparison Matrix](https://cbtmocks.online/about.html#comparison): Side-by-side comparison between CBTMocks (100% free forever) and commercial coaching institutes.
- [Contact & Paper Submissions](https://cbtmocks.online/contact.html): Student support, missing slot question paper submissions, and feedback.
